It also ensures that applicants understand the need to obtain all necessary permits from other review agencies. As a result, staff recommends that all special events currently requiring an AP should continue to do so, and the proposal will not introduce new event types that require an AP.

Staff recommends a two-tiered AP approach. The proposed Tier 1 AP would be applicable to short-term events that have minimal impact due to their limited duration and scope. Examples of such events include grand openings for retail or similar events.

The proposed standards include the following with options provided shown in blue on the screen. Each event is limited to one day and must last no more than eight hours, excluding setup and breakdown times. There must be a minimum of five days between each one-day event.

Lastly, an application fee of $120 is proposed. Any event that exceeds these standards may be approved as an AP Tier 2. The current average review timeline in reviewing the all special event administrative permits currently is around 13 days approximately.

And staff anticipates completion of review of Tier 1 APs within one to three days, given that the AP events would be more streamlined. Depending on whether or not there would be review required by other agencies or there is additional revisions requested from the applicant.

The proposed Tier 2 would apply to long-term uses that may have additional impacts on adjacent properties due to their extent, duration, and operational scope. Examples of such uses include seasonal Christmas tree sales, cultural festivals, and concert series.

As proposed, the Tier 2 AP would increase the special event duration from the current 21-day limit per event to up to a maximum of 60 days. However, since seasonal sales and events such as carnivals and circuses may be held on consecutive days and can significantly impact nearby properties, a shorter duration is recommended for these uses.

Specifically, seasonal sales is proposed to be limited to 45 days and 21 days is proposed for carnivals or circuses. Lastly, staff proposes to keep the current special event fee of $240 for the Tier 2 AP.
